name: WristTrack
description: Track your watch collection, log what's on your wrist, sync with atomic time, and analyse  your wearing habits—offline-first with optional cloud sync.

features.title: Manage Your Watch Collection
features.description: Add detailed specs, purchase history, and notes for every watch in your collection, wishlist, or archive.

features.title: Track What You Wear
features.description: Quickly log what's on your wrist and view interactive charts and monthly Wrist Recaps to see what gets the most wrist time.

features.title: Atomic Time & GMT
features.description: Set your mechanical watches accurately with network time synced to atomic clocks, plus multi-timezone GMT tracking.

features.title: Track Accuracy
features.description: Log timing checkpoints against atomic time to calculate your timepiece's drift in seconds per day, month, or year.

features.title: Gallery & Multi-Photo
features.description: Save up to three images per watch—dial, caseback, or strap combos—and showcase your box in full-screen gallery view.

features.title: Local-First + Optional Cloud Sync
features.description: Works completely offline with fast local storage, or sign in to sync across iPhone, iPad, and Android devices.

features.title: Daily Wear Reminders
features.description: Set custom daily reminders so you never forget to log your morning or evening watch swap.

features.title: Instant Real-Time Search
features.description: Find any watch in a large collection immediately—filter by status, movement, or lug width for strap swaps.

features.title: Always Free Core + Pro Extras
features.description: Core collection and wear tracking are always free. Upgrade with a one-off 'Pay What You Like' donation to remove ads and unlock Pro nerd stats.
